03 modular audio lab

sound

A modular experimental sound engine crafting ambient soundscapes and audio experiences.

We specialize in creating immersive soundscapes that transport listeners into states of deep presence and contemplation.

— focus areas
  • 01 Ambient production and meditative audio experiences ambient
  • 02 Sound design for digital experiences and installations design
  • 03 Music scoring for film and therapeutic applications scoring
  • 04 Experimental audio research and conscious sound creation research
— philosophy

every sound is intentional.
every frequency serves presence.

Our modular approach combines vintage analog warmth with cutting-edge digital precision, creating a sonic palette that bridges the organic and the electronic.

— signal chain
  • in Field recordings, acoustic sources, modular voltage capture
  • proc Analog colour, granular and generative processing shape
  • out Records, scores, installations, and app soundtracks release
